plugins.description: React/TypeScript frontend + Go backend enforcement harness. 91 wired hooks (100 scripts) enforce patterns on every edit. Green != done: `test-warning-check` + `ci-warning-audit` block passing tests with DeprecationWarning / React `act()` / unhandled rejection noise (local + `gh run view --log` on green CI). 48 skills from TDD through CI-green PR, including /steelman anti-sycophancy guard + /snyk-ux-security JS+Go per-path vuln sweep (exploitability-triage first gate via `bun why`/`go mod why`/`govulncheck`; top-level direct dep bump first, parent dep second, resolutions/overrides/replace last resort only; React 18 pin + changelog-walked majors + no-deferral escalation; Go `go get -u` + `go mod tidy` + `govulncheck` verify). 21 LLM failure modes enforced (7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent, Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025). OWASP + STRIDE + snyk/bun audit. Core Web Vitals perf gate. bun.lock + yarn.lock parity enforced. Worktree isolation + branch safety. MCP ban with CLI redirect (~20x savings). Agent-browser integration (~91% token reduction). 9 agents (3-hat plan review + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.4.9.0: 2026-04-23 -- Green != done warnings gate (+2 hooks, 89->91 wired / 98->100 scripts). `test-warning-check.sh` (PostToolUse Bash) scans passing `vitest`/`bun test`/`playwright`/`tsgo`/`biome`/`lint` output for curated patterns: Node `DeprecationWarning` + `ExperimentalWarning` + `(node:...) XxxWarning`, React `act()`/missing-key/DOM-nesting/prop-type/bad-setstate/non-boolean-attr, unhandled rejection / unhandled error, vitest `stderr |` during test, skipped-test counts, `@ts-expect-error` / `@ts-ignore`, `npm WARN deprecated`. Per-finding escape `// allow: test-warning` in test file; env `TEST_WARNINGS_ALLOW=1`. 3x same-kind streak escalates. `ci-warning-audit.sh` (Stop) fetches `gh run view --log` on green PR CI (per-SHA cache, 45s timeout), greps same pattern, warns with file:line sample. Gates: feature branch, session touched code, PR exists, all checks SUCCESS. Disable via `CI_WARNING_AUDIT=0`. CLAUDE.md Tests section adds green-not-done rule. /tdd `When Done` checklist adds zero-warnings local + CI log audit. Why: tests can be green while runtime spews deprecations / logs errors / leaks unhandled rejections -- noise that rots into real bugs when the libs actually remove the API. Agent must now clean before calling it done.
x-changelog.4.8.0: 2026-04-22 -- /steelman anti-sycophancy skill, opt-in via slash only. Forces strongest counter-case with repo evidence before agreeing with user claims (factual/causal/architectural only -- preference/goal/scope declined). No ambient CLAUDE.md rule, no automatic hook, no telemetry script -- plugin consumers see zero behavior change unless they type `/steelman`. Skills 47 -> 48.
x-changelog.4.7.0: 2026-04-22 -- /snyk-ux-security: exploitability-triage first-gate + top-level-first upgrade ladder + Go ecosystem parity. Per finding decide REACHABLE vs NOT-REACHABLE before any bump (`bun why` / `go mod why` + direct-import grep + symbol-usage check). Not-reachable -> dismiss via `snyk ignore --id=<id> --reason='<why>' --expiry=<ISO>` + PR `Dismissed (not exploitable)` table (SLA audit trail, expiry forces re-triage). Upgrade ladder: direct dep bump first -> parent dep bump second -> `resolutions`/`overrides`/`replace` last resort only (with follow-up TODO to remove once upstream fixes; overrides do not scale + bloat lockfiles). Go track parallel to JS: ecosystem auto-detect (`package.json` vs `go.mod`), `snyk test --file=go.mod`, `govulncheck` reachability, `go get -u` then `go mod tidy`, `go build/test/vet` + `govulncheck` verify, `lang/go` label, `replace` directive last resort. Preserves React 18 pin, bun-only JS runtime, dual-lockfile invariant, never-defer real vulns. +23 evals. Full suite 1819/1819.
